text.title: FreshDrop, busy families with children, Moscow, interviews August 2026
text.quote: «If the slot is gone, I order from the shop next door.»
text.goals: Dinner on the table without a trip to the shop, around the kids' schedule
text.personal: Less guilt about shopping; one fixed slot she can plan her evening around
text.management: Household budget: keeps the monthly grocery spend under 25,000 RUB
text.criteria: 1) a fixed slot; 2) fresh produce; 3) prices within 5% of the store
text.barriers: Fear of substitutions; card-only payment; a slot that is not reliable
text.approval: She decides alone; her partner checks the monthly bill
text.budget: Household grocery budget of 25,000 RUB a month, paid by her card
text.alternatives: The shop next door with a queue; a rival app with 2-hour slots; skipping the order
text.decision: put the slot guarantee first, remove the card-only barrier, hand the family plan to sales; review 1 November 2026
